description: ipssrl.com zoominfo.com/c/ips-srl/372710487 I.P.S. Srl is an Italian company founded in 2005 that specializes in the recovery and recycling of inert waste from construction and demolition activities. They provide environmental services, supply recycled aggregates, and manufacture "Wastile," a 100% ecological and infinitely recyclable thermoplastic tile. The company has received national awards for its rapid revenue growth and high financial reliability in the environmental sector.
